gaps.explanation: The report itself does not add up; no printed line carries the 58,982. General Fund Schedule 3 (trimmed pp5-8, printed pp22-25, consecutive) prints TOTAL CASH DISBURSEMENTS 689,434 (p8) = Exhibit B General Fund column (p2), but its printed object lines add to 630,452, every one of which is in detail[]: general government department lines 429,482 (printed 'Total general government' 429,001 on p6 even omits Zoning 481), Total Public Safety 154,744, Total Public Works 18,239, Total Public Welfare and Social Services 27,987 (3,501 + 24,486). 689,434 - 630,452 = 58,982 = gap; Exhibit B prints General Fund General government 488,464 = 429,482 + 58,982, so the unitemized amount is general government, but no row prints it on the schedule. Adding the Exhibit B General Fund function lines would count 630,452 twice; a 58,982 line would be derived. All other fund columns are fully in detail: Road and Bridge Schedule 4 (p9) 529,964, Inheritance Tax Fund Schedule 5 (p10) receipts 52,522 and Operating transfers in 17,017, every nonmajor Schedule 1 (p4) cell including Operating transfers in 30,000 / 3,000 / 28,996, and General Fund Operating transfers out (79,013). Eliminations column (79,013 / (79,013)) is not a fund column. No bond/loan proceeds or other-financing rows printed. Nothing printed is missing.
